definitions: In Jewish mysticism, particularly Kabbalah, Chochmah (or Hokhmah) is the second of the ten sefirot, and the first of the intellectual sefirot. It is often associated with the faculty of wisdom, the initial flash of an idea, or the primordial point of creation.
It represents the masculine principle and is paired with Binah (understanding), which represents the feminine principle. Together, they form the intellectual foundation of the Tree of Life.
examples: The study of Kabbalah often begins with an understanding of Chochmah and Binah.
He meditated on the concept of Chochmah to gain deeper insight.
Chochmah is often described as pure, undifferentiated wisdom.
